implemented.detail: Authored rolling snapshots use start cash + occurring income − occurring expenses − accepted due-week goal spending. The next week carries forward cash after goals. Negative-cash detection scans actual computed snapshots.
implemented.qualification: Not audited against a comprehensive native test suite. Native weekly grouping can conceal intraweek payment ordering.

implemented.feature: Decimal money and explicit year-week identity
implemented.detail: Decimal financial values and YearWeek avoid treating repeating week numbers as globally unique. Calendar-year weeks begin Monday; the implementation is not the older Australian financial-year v8 approach.

implemented.feature: Recurring income/expense definitions with edit history
implemented.detail: Stable UUID and seriesId, amount, start/end dates, frequencies. Ongoing edits stop an old series instance and clone a new future instance; upcoming edits apply in place.
Authored SwiftData cash truth anchors, total/protected values and guided calibration. Protected cash differs from the dynamic forecasting floor.
Authored goal target/date/state, lock-first and due-date ordering, viability checks and due-week planned spending; unviable goals are skipped rather than allowed to consume cash.
Authored card limit/balance/billing day, one active debt invariant, planned borrowing and repayment entries, debt pay/destroy operations, goal acceleration and survival rescue mechanisms.
implemented.qualification: Planning code exists, but accuracy of safe-borrow capacity and real interest-free eligibility is not established. No automatic bank/card payments.

validationGaps.detail: Retained model stores limit, balance, active flag, policy and billing day. It does not model APR, fees, a separate statement closing date/payment due date, grace-period eligibility, minimum payments, cash advances, promotional terms or lender-specific exceptions. Do not imply universal interest-free access.

repaymentCapacity sums positive projectedAvailableCash minus floor over successive weeks. Those values are cash stocks, not independently earned weekly surpluses; carried cash can be counted repeatedly. This is a source-review concern requiring financial model validation before any safe-borrow claim.

Some comments describe survival-only goals or non-carried dips while current rolling projection carries after-goal cash and flags negative after-goal balances. Credit billing helper comments and implementation also differ. Describe observed code narrowly rather than treating every comment as completed intent.

Native projections group occurrences by week. A salary later in the same week can offset a bill earlier in the week, concealing a temporary day-level shortfall. New browser simulation uses explicit event dates/order and must document its own same-day assumption.
The retained primary test file is the generated empty example test. Debug invariant assertions exist in the engine but are not a comprehensive financial test suite.
